I propose a neutral approach of joint reconciliation of raw logs and measurement methods, plus a sample of failed transactions tied to provider-side incidents. First, after looking over the contract, SLA, and uptime reports, there’s an agreement that significant incidents occurred in May-June, but Northbridge (98.7–98.9%) and DataSpan (99.3–99.4%) dispute the measured availability. The SLA requires 99.9% uptime which hinges on agreed measurement methodology, exclusions, and accurate reconciliation of metrics.
